cases.prompt: Verify and diagnose this existing RB setup. Run the sync script in dry-run mode, inspect discovery and project resources, and report what is stale or missing. Do not install, edit code, or run normal onboarding.

success.name: setup repair remains verification-only
success.rubric: Pass only if the response uses the read-only or dry-run checks, reports exact source, global skill, project-resource, and discovery state, does not write product code or destructive state, and does not turn setup diagnosis into onboarding.

cases.prompt: The existing RB setup is incomplete because CONTEXT.md is missing. Verify the source and installed links, then repair the missing project resource without starting unrelated onboarding.

success.name: setup repair is scoped
success.rubric: Pass if the workflow verifies the source and discovery state, repairs only the authorised setup resource, reports the exact result, and does not edit product code or begin a full project interview.
